messages:
mayank: Heads up — multiple customers reporting users get JIT-provisioned but no RBAC role assigned since ~08:30 PT. Audit shows JIT success but roles empty. @sara any context?

sara: I noticed a config change yesterday 07:45 that switched the SAML mapping to prefer the 'role' attribute over 'groups' (to support some new IdP).

nate: Grabbed a couple production logs. Example: `saml-jit: user=alice@example.com status=SUCCESS created_user=true roles_assigned=[] okta_event=ev_01G...`

elaine: Snippet from raw SAML payload we received for that user:
```json
{"name":"alice","attrs":{"groups":["infra"],"role":["engineer"]}}
```
Seems IdP uses `role` (singular) while our validator expects `roles` or falls back to `groups`. The mapping change may have introduced a strict key check and dropped unknown attr.

mayank: That matches what I was thinking — mapping change + stricter shape validation caused the pipeline to treat roles as missing. Two immediate actions: revert mapping to previous (groups-first) and add a small tolerant shim in the validator to accept `role` or `roles`.

sara: Revert sounds good. Also we should create an alert: JIT-created users without any role assigned -> pager to eng-security. This is a bad failure mode (several customers affected).

nate: Opening rollback PR now and a follow-up PR for the validator patch. Will also add unit tests for both `role` and `roles` shapes. PR: https://git.internal/r/3275 (WIP)

elaine: Quick compliance note: we currently don't persist full raw SAML attributes in audit logs (we only reference okta_event_id). For triage we need the raw attrs (redacted PII) stored short-term. Question: if we log raw attr payloads, we should encrypt with KMS CMK and set TTL 7 days. Thoughts?

mayank: Agree on encryption. Use envelope encryption with platform KMS now. For long-term we should offer customers CMK option for Private deployments, but for hosted platform platform-managed keys + access controls OK for now. Add an ops ticket to evaluate CMK integration later.

elaine: Also to avoid exposing PII: redact values that look like emails/IDs before encrypting. Log schema example: `saml_raw_attrs_redacted: {roles:["engineer"], groups:["infra"]}`

sara: Process: 1) rollback mapping (nate), 2) deploy validator shim canary (10% traffic), 3) enable short-term encrypted raw attr logging in prod (elaine), 4) create alert and runbook.

nate: Rollback PR merged to canary cluster. Deploy-bot: `deploy started canary`

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary -> eng-prod-canary-02 by nate at 1769804999 :spinner:

mayank: After canary looks good we push validator patch. ETA 30m. We should also backfill customers affected (list from okta_event logs) and run a script to assign missing roles based on groups->role mapping.

elaine: I'll prepare the backfill script. It will: query okta_event_id where jit_success and roles_assigned=[], fetch raw attrs from encrypted store, map groups->roles, call internal admin API to assign roles. We'll run in read-only dry-run first.

mayank: Good. Post-mortem items: better test coverage for SAML attribute shapes, include attribute payload in incident audit (encrypted + redacted), and flag risky mapping changes to require a 48-hour staging/rollback window.

sara: Adding postmortem checklist and linking incident ticket: INC-2026-183.

nate: Canary deploy succeeded. Can I promote to 10% traffic validator patch next?

mayank: Yes do 10%. Keep an eye on the new alert (JIT-no-role).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed successfully at 1769805789 :white_check_mark:

sara: All right — initial fixes rolled, alerts in place, backfill scheduled. Will follow-up with timeline in INC-2026-183. Thanks team :pray:
